item.title: Hong Kong: Simplifying Cross-Border Radiology Record Integration
item.description: Hong Kong’s eHealth platform now enables residents to securely integrate overseas radiology reports and images into their electronic medical records, improving cross-border care continuity and data interoperability.

item.title: Vietnam: Artificial Intelligence as Key Driver for Development
item.description: Vietnam is leveraging artificial intelligence as a strategic foundation to drive innovation, strengthen national competitiveness and achieve sustainable, long-term science and technology–driven growth.

item.title: Singapore: Preparing Workers for AI and the Future of Work
item.description: Singapore Management University has launched the Resilient Workforces Institute to study the impact of AI and digital technologies on jobs, skills and lifelong learning, equipping the workforce with resilience for the future.

item.title: Singapore: SMU Empowering Workforce Resilience in the Age of AI
item.description: Singapore Management University has launched the Resilient Workforces Institute to advance workforce resilience, lifelong learning and AI-driven skills for Singapore’s rapidly evolving economy and workforce.

item.title: Malaysia: Federal Funding to Accelerate Selangor Smart City Vision
item.description: Selangor has secured approximately US$95 million in federal funding to advance its smart city initiative significantly, further enhancing digital infrastructure, data-driven governance and integrated urban services.

item.title: Australia: Enhancing Operational Technology Resilience
item.description: The Australian Signals Directorate, in collaboration with partners, has released Secure Connectivity Principles for Operational Technology to help organisations strengthen cyber resilience and safely harness digital connectivity.

item.title: India: BHASHINI Leads National Push for Inclusive Multilingual AI
item.description: The Digital India BHASHINI Division is actively advancing AI-driven multilingual tools and standardised geospatial data to enhance governance, digital inclusion and citizen-centric services across India.

item.title: Hong Kong: Smart Automation Boosts EV Battery Recycling
item.description: Hong Kong is developing a smart, fully automated production line to recycle end-of-life electric vehicle batteries into black mass, strengthening green manufacturing, resilience, and the circular economy.

item.title: The Philippines: iMessage Simplifies Transactions, Builds Confidence
item.description: The SEC has expanded its digital services, including the iMessage Online Ticketing System and SEC-ZERO, to streamline business registration, post-registration processes and investor protection.

item.title: Singapore: Driving SME Growth with Digital Transformation, AI
item.description: Singapore’s SMEs are encouraged to adopt practical AI and digital tools, continuously develop skills, strong capabilities and foster experimentation to drive growth, competitiveness and future-ready businesses.
